title: vLLM - 服务状态
description: Comprehensive vLLM request statistics: latency, throughput, queue, scheduler, cache, and reliability — unified from multiple vLLM dashboards into one optimized view with per-instance filtering.

panels.title: Total Requests
panels.description: Total number of completed requests within the selected time range.

panels.title: Current Running
panels.description: Number of requests currently in RUNNING state (actively being processed).

panels.title: Current Waiting
panels.description: Number of requests currently in WAITING state (queued, not yet processing).

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Percentage of requests that finished with 'stop' or 'length' reason, indicating successful completion.

panels.title: Scheduler Efficiency
panels.description: Ratio of running requests to total (running + waiting). Higher values indicate the scheduler is keeping GPUs busy.

targets.expr: sum(vllm:num_requests_running{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) / clamp_min(sum(vllm:num_requests_running{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) + sum(vllm:num_requests_waiting{model_name=~"$model_name", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}), 1)

panels.title: TTFT vs Queue Time (Root Cause)
panels.description: TTFT P99 vs Queue P99 on dual axes. If TTFT rises but queue doesn't, the bottleneck is in prefill processing — not queueing.

panels.title: TPOT (Time Per Output Token)
panels.description: Time per output token latency percentile distribution in seconds.

panels.title: Running & Waiting Requests
panels.description: Number of requests in RUNNING and WAITING state over time. Shows the concurrent processing load and queue backlog.

panels.title: Queue Wait Time
panels.description: Average and percentile queue wait times. Shows how long requests queue before processing.

panels.title: KV Cache Hit Rate Breakdown
panels.description: Breakdown of prefix-cache hit rate from vLLM local GPU prefix cache and external KV connector cache.

panels.title: Requests per Minute
panels.description: Rate of incoming requests per minute.

panels.title: Completed Requests Over Time
panels.description: Cumulative completed request count over the selected time range, broken down by finish reason.

panels.title: E2E Request Latency
panels.description: End-to-end request latency percentile distribution in seconds.

panels.title: Inference Stage Breakdown
panels.description: Average prefill and decode time per request. Shows the inference time budget split.

panels.title: Token Throughput
panels.description: Input and output token processing rates in tokens per second.

panels.title: Token I/O Ratio
panels.description: Ratio of input to output token rates. Values above 5 indicate high prompt processing overhead relative to generation.

panels.title: Throughput vs Success Rate
panels.description: Total request throughput vs successful request throughput over time.

panels.title: Peak Concurrency
panels.description: Maximum number of simultaneously running requests observed in the selected time range.

panels.title: GPU KV Cache Usage
panels.description: GPU KV cache utilization percentage. Values above 80% risk preemptions; above 95% is critical.

panels.title: Prefix Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: Prefix cache hit rate from vLLM local GPU prefix cache.

panels.title: Cache <-> Waiting Correlation
panels.description: KV cache usage and waiting request count on dual axes. Rising cache usage followed by rising wait count reveals the causal chain of cache pressure leading to queueing.

panels.title: Scheduler State
panels.description: Running, waiting, and swapped request counts. Stacked view shows total scheduler load.

panels.title: Finish Reason Distribution
panels.description: Completed request count by finish reason as stacked bars. stop = normal EOS, length = max tokens reached, abort = interrupted.

panels.title: Finish Reason Pie
panels.description: Distribution of request finish reasons as a pie chart.
